decisions.question: Which hero film?
decisions.context: The real dashboard, filmed frame by frame on a made-up fleet: a session asks to read a query plan, is approved, hands a delegate to dev-vm, and the delegate reports back. 12 s, loops on its first frame, no sound. Each film differs from the first in one thing.

options.label: Whole window, still camera
options.detail: The whole dashboard, nothing moves but the product.
options.facts: MP4 2.31 MB · WebM 3.15 MB · 12 s · 60 fps

options.label: Whole window, slow lean in
options.detail: The camera leans in 6% as the session asks, and back out as the delegate reports.
options.facts: MP4 3.47 MB · WebM 2.30 MB · 12 s · 60 fps

options.label: Close on the session
options.detail: Framed on the session and its composer, without the rail.
options.facts: MP4 2.22 MB · WebM 2.96 MB · 12 s · 60 fps

options.label: No film: keep the hero as it is
options.detail: Today's page, with no product picture near the top.
